en.title: Native media project
en.context: Manual camera and microphone test. Only brightness and RMS values reach this project's server. No media is recorded or uploaded.
en.consumer: Projection consumes project results. It never opens a device or runs input analysis.
en.idle: Inputs are off. Choose an input, then enable it manually.
en.active: Input enabled. Other windows keep their own inputs.
en.failed: Input unavailable. Check the system permission and selected device; another window was not closed. Stop this page's inputs before switching if the system requires it. Error:
en.storage: Browser storage is unavailable. Independent identity could not be verified; this page's inputs remain off.
en.network: Project connection interrupted. The current document and its manually enabled inputs are retained.
en.observations: Recently received project samples (server expiry: 5 seconds). These numbers do not establish hardware or permission status.

zh-CN.title: 原生媒体测试工程
zh-CN.context: 手动测试摄像头与麦克风。工程服务器只收到亮度和 RMS 数值，不记录或上传媒体。
zh-CN.consumer: 投影只消费工程结果，不打开设备或运行输入分析。
zh-CN.idle: 输入已停用。选择设备后手动启用。
zh-CN.active: 输入已启用，其他窗口保持各自输入。
zh-CN.failed: 输入不可用。请检查系统权限和所选设备；其他窗口未被关闭。系统若要求切换前停用，请先停用本页输入。错误：
zh-CN.storage: 浏览器存储不可用，无法核对独立身份，本页输入保持停用。
zh-CN.network: 工程连接暂时中断；保留当前文档与已手动启用的输入。
zh-CN.observations: 最近收到的工程特征（服务器 5 秒后过期）。数值本身不代表硬件或权限状态。
zh-CN.noResults: 没有最近收到的工程特征。
